test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: At what rate (in percentage) per annum will ₹1,300 give ₹650 as simple interest in 10 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹1,300

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹650

Time (t) = 10 years

**Formula used:**

SI = P × R × T / 100

Where, R = rate

**Calculations:**

650 = 1300 × R × 10 / 100

⇒ 650 = 13000R / 100

⇒ 650 = 130R

⇒ R = 650 / 130

⇒ R = 5%

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
